Domestic Oil Business Distributor Management System
is an Domestic Oil Distributor Management System built
as a full-stack PHP web application to manage the sale and distribution of cold-
pressed homemade Indian oils. The system connects the oil producer directly with
retail and bulk customers through a modern e-commerce-style interface.
The platform was developed after identifying that small-scale traditional oil
producers lack a digital presence, rely on word-of-mouth for orders, and have no
inquiries. This project bridges that gap.

Before this system, Sangameshwar Oil operated entirely through informal channels.
Customers would place orders via phone calls or WhatsApp messages. Order
records were maintained in paper notebooks. There was no way to view product
availability, compare prices, or track order status. Payments were made in cash at
time of delivery with no digital receipt.
The admin had no centralized view of total revenue, pending orders, or customer
data. Stock was tracked manually with no alert for low stock. Bulk inquiries were
received over calls and not systematically recorded. There was no structured way to
add new products or update prices.
The Domestic Oil Distributor Management System introduces a complete digital
A public website (home.php) showcases all products with pricing, stock status,
and product details,allowing customers to discover and register before ordering.
A secure customer dashboard (dashboard.php) enables authenticated users to
browse live inventory,place orders with quantity selection, pay using multiple
methods, and track their order history.
A payment module (payment.php) handles the full checkout flow with stock
locking, order numbergeneration, payment recording, and stock deduction in a
visibility: revenue stats, ordermanagement, customer list, inventory control with
stock history, inquiry management, and product-level sales reports.
Role-based session authentication ensures customers can only access the user
dashboard, andadmins can only access the admin panel.
